# rallyup

> rallyup (rallyup.team) is a done-for-you LinkedIn ghostwriting and audience-building agency for B2B founders and executives. Human writers create thought-leadership posts in each executive's own voice, the executive approves everything in Slack, and rallyup turns the resulting audience into pipeline.

Not to be confused with RallyUp (rallyup.com), the online fundraising platform. The two companies are unrelated.

## What rallyup does

- Executive LinkedIn ghostwriting: up to 3 posts a week per executive, written by a dedicated human writer. AI is used for research, never for the writing.
- Voice and context: each executive starts with an onboarding form and works with their writer at least monthly. Every post draws on the executive's own experience, company, market and buyers.
- Approval: the weekly content plan arrives in Slack. The executive approves, edits or rejects every post before it goes live.
- Reporting: impressions, follower growth, profile views, ICP connection requests and inbound DMs.
- Pipeline add-ons: allbound campaigns, ABM and Dream 100 lists built on the executive's audience.
- Single executives or whole leadership teams. Most clients start with one executive, then roll it out.

## Who it is for

B2B founders, CEOs and C-suite executives, mostly in B2B SaaS, AI, fintech and venture capital, who want LinkedIn to drive inbound, partnerships, hiring and pipeline, and who have expertise but no time to write.

## Results (public case studies)

- PandaDoc ($100M+ ARR B2B SaaS): 27,000+ impressions on one executive's first post; 1,235 engagements across 3 executives in one month. https://rallyup.team/case-studies/pandadoc.html
- Deway (CEO): 20,238 impressions in month one, about 4x baseline; 4 prospect calls in under a month. https://rallyup.team/case-studies/deway.html
- PrettyDamnQuick (CEO): 20 new ABM accounts opened in month one. https://rallyup.team/case-studies/prettydamnquick.html

Clients include executives at Airwallex, PandaDoc, Letter AI, Walnut, Deway, Anchor Browser, Andel, PrettyDamnQuick, Raptive and Lightbank.
